newsitem.title: UK: UBS raises 1997 United News forecast.
newsitem.headline: UBS raises 1997 United News forecast.

text.p: Broker UBS said on Friday it was increasing its current year profit forecast for United News & Media Plc after 1996 figures topped forecasts.

"They have delivered on what they said at the time of the merger," analyst Colin Tennant said, adding he planned to increase his 1997 forecast for pre-tax profit from 297 million stg pounds to around 310 million.
United News, which merged last year with MAI, earlier announced pre-tax profit of 290.2 million pounds, excluding exceptional items, a rise of 12 percent.

Tennant said that United had assembled a strong management team and taken action to tackle problem areas such as Express Newspapers. He added that the integration of trade exhibitions group Blenheim appeared to be going well.
